Chapter 6689: Don’T Be Greedy

Chapter 6689: Don’t Be Greedy

“Boom!” Another two beams of light erupted from the redemption grounds.

Spectators saw Primal Yin Immortal Ghost and Bao Pu at last. The ghost appeared in Fiendish Ground and Bao Pu appeared in Evil Transformation, taking over.

“How can this be?!” This development shocked all spectators.

“You!” The two immortals’ expression soured.

“If I am an avatar, it’s time for me to take over!” Primal Yin Immortal Ghost roared and a black eye appeared behind him.

It opened and stabilized the redemption ground. The power here resembled ghastly energy that had been accumulated for epochs. Instead of pulsing outward, it surged into the ghost and turned him into a bottomless abyss.

This naturally infuriated Fiendish Ground but he couldn’t do anything about it. Normally, the ghost didn’t have this opportunity. The eye behind him was always under Fiendish Ground’s control until now.

The ghost, or Luminous Master, was chosen as an avatar once. Because of this, he possessed the power of the redemption ground within him. After gaining Zhan Sansheng’s help, he escaped the redemption ground’s control and severed the connection. Nevertheless, he kept certain techniques and methods within.

Since he shared the same source, he could take over the redemption ground in Fiendish Ground’s absence.

“Time for a new owner.” Bao Pu made his move and the worm inside his chest leaped out, opening its horrific mouth.

Stars shot out and turned into mouths, aiming for the center of Evil Transformation’s redemption ground. The mouths descended like a waterfall and roared as if ravenous.

“Buzz.” They drilled into the ground and absorbed the redemption ground’s essences.

This worm came from the redemption ground so this was a return to home. It was too familiar with this area, accelerating the absorption efficiency.

“Seniors, thank you for entering your astral form and leaving your foundation. We couldn’t have done this otherwise.” Weizhen told the two immortals. It seemed this plan had been concocted long ago by the group. Bao Pu and the ghost had no reason to refuse.

“Activate!” The two immortals were livid and grew larger, wanting to take back their redemption ground.

The situation deteriorated for them since as they grew bigger, so did the number of tribulation bolts. More flesh and blood splattered outward.

Nevertheless, they became large enough to push the ring away.

“Hurry, don’t be greedy!” Weizhen shouted at the ghost and Bao Pu.

“Very well.” The two had reached an unprecedented level of power.

Bao Pu had an immortal radiance that illuminated all of Three Immortals. The ghost was even more magical since he fused perfectly with the redemption ground. He took in all the ghastly energy and turned the ground into a maelstrom with him in the center.

The ghost in his abyssal form was empowered by the great eye, wrapping around Evil Transformation’s astral form.

Bao Pu directed his immortal worm toward Fiendish Ground. Normally, the worm wouldn’t be able to bite through a primordial immortal’s shell but since it had absorbed primordial power from the primordial ground, it broke through successfully.

The two swapped targets - the ghost wanted to devour Evil Transformation using Fiendish Ground’s power while Bao Pu went for Fiendish Ground.

“Ahh!” The two primordial immortals suffered three attacks in unison and grew weaker.
